title: Forehead Stroking
summary: Very light movements travel from the center of the forehead toward the temples.
goal: Gently relax the superficial forehead tissues.
instructions: Place the finger pads at the center of the forehead.
direction: From the center of the forehead toward the temples.
warning: Do not massage damaged or inflamed skin. Stop with dizziness, worsening headache, pain, or other unusual symptoms.
